_comment: The Colour family's shared attack-pattern pool, read out of the Xros Wars firmware at 0x240B8 by utilities/claude/extract_colour_patterns.py. Fifteen rows of six rounds, weakest first, row 14 the Megahit. A battle packet's word 6 is an INDEX INTO THIS TABLE -- which is what every Colour line's selector turns out to be, and is the encoding seven device readings could not derive on their own.
shared_by: All 28 rows measured off a real Pendulum Color are here, using all 15 entries, and all 7 PENC selectors read off the wire are exactly the pool index. The SELECTION table -- which row a stage and charge pick -- is per line and is not shared.
six_rounds: Every row is six values, not five. Omnipet plays five, and PENC's hit mask has twice been seen with bit 5 set, which is a sixth round. The sixth value is stored here as read; whether a battle ever reaches it is a separate question.
